setup.description: Install and verify rust, select its version, and publish its environment for subsequent tasks.

version.description: Tool release or supported channel to install; omitted values use the documented default.

installDir.description: Absolute per-user installation prefix; omit for native package installations.

packageName.description: Native package or port selector overriding the default repository package name.

sudo.description: Use noninteractive sudo for native package or system installation; defaults to false.

toolchain.description: Rustup toolchain channel or exact release; alias for version. Both must agree when provided.

components.description: Rustup components to install, such as rustfmt and clippy.

targets.description: Rust target triples to install, such as wasm32-wasip2.

profile.description: Rustup installation profile: minimal (default), default, or complete.
